description:
Free disk space at the VERY END, once everything works: remove the staged Odoo
    `.deb` installer(s) from /opt/odoo/artifacts (EE ≈285 MB) and clear the apt archive
    cache. SAFE - the playbook refuses unless Odoo is active AND returns HTTP 200, so it
    never deletes an installer a still-broken box would need for a reinstall.
name: cleanup_install
